subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Steady
solution: The correct answer is **"Wavering."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Steady"** means consistent or unchanging. (नियमित गति से और क्रमशः विकसित होता, बढ़ता और घटित होता हुआ) • **Example**: *That was a **steady**__ decline.* • The antonym of** "Steady"** is **"Wavering."** • **"Wavering"** means unsteady or indecisive. (यह तय करने की क्षमता का अभाव कि दो संभावनाओं में से किसे चुनना है) __ • **Example**: *He spoke in a **wavering**__ voice, as if he were not sure of his ground.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Contrived**, means artificial or forced. (अविश्‍वसनीय; अस्‍वाभाविक या अयथार्थ) • **Option 2, Voluntary**, means done willingly or by choice. (अपनी इच्‍छा से (न कि विवशता से) किया या दिया गया; स्‍वैच्‍छिक) • **Option 3, Undeviating**, means constant or unwavering. (अविचल) 32:Tc13, The correct answer is **"assaulted."**
